name: Bring Back the Mug
label: Quest
description: Durnan Furcutter sends you back across Coldridge Valley with Nori Pridedrift's empty mug. Returning it brings the Mornbrew delivery to a close.

clips.title: The story
paras: Durnan Furcutter sends you back across Coldridge Valley with Nori Pridedrift's empty mug. Returning it brings the Mornbrew delivery to a close.

Durnan Furcutter has finished warming himself with the Mornbrew you delivered across Dun Morogh's snowdrifts. Now he sends you back with the empty tankard. In the biting cold, dwarven hospitality depends on mutual respect, and good dishware must not be left behind.

Your return to Coldridge Valley completes the delivery for Nori Pridedrift. Sturdy drinkware does not grow on trees, especially in the dwarven homeland's subzero crags. Bringing the empty vessel back in one piece shows that you can be trusted in the local community.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that hit the spot! Nothing like a piping hot - nay, SCALDING mornbrew on a cold winter's day to warm your cackles of yer soul.
Here ya go friend - be a pal and take this empty mug back to Nori for me, would ya now.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time! Did you remember to bring me back my mug?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, friend! You'd be surprised how many couriers I meet who forget to do something as simple as bring back the mug. Mugs don't grow on trees, or so they tell me!
Here's a little something for the effort. Thanks again for your help.
